item.title: Rallying Cry – November 5, 2026
item.description: From Ukraine securing €4.36 billion in EU support to seabirds making a triumphant comeback after avian flu, today’s good news includes a historic climate-focused midterm wave and Bob Dylan’s unexpected Vatican serenade.
